{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-uk8heo",
      "toKey": "n-1rpd0or",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The blank temporary instruction field (condition) indicates that no approved change documentation was attached at issue time. This absence of a valid authorization record is the direct cause for the lack of an authorized line opening.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-1yf38nl", "claim-gyysd1", "claim-1i3o10f"],
      "counterfactual": "If a valid temporary instruction had been attached and authorized, the line opening would have been permitted under procedure.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; procedural requirements link documentation status directly to authorization capability.",
      "evidenceGap": "The specific mechanism by which 'no attachment' leads to 'no opening' is standard procedure logic (Section 3.6 of IA-D03), not an unknown physical gap."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1rpd0or",
      "toKey": "n-14tzgyz",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Because no line opening was authorized (condition), the crew could not legally or procedurally isolate the system. This procedural constraint prevented them from verifying valve states or confirming supply continuity before proceeding.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If authorization had been granted, the crew could have performed isolation checks to verify valve states.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; procedural constraints are binary (authorized/not authorized).",
      "evidenceGap": "The exact moment of interruption relative to the lack of opening is unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-14tzgyz",
      "toKey": "n-uk8heo",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The point register maps signals but does not prove every disturbance appears in the sample export. This limitation means that even if a supply interruption occurred, it might not have been captured by P-R or AL-44 readings available to operators.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the point register captured all disturbances, an interruption would have been recorded in P-R or AL-44.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; this is a documented limitation of the monitoring system (IA-P02).",
      "evidenceGap": "The actual pressure values at time of interruption are unknown."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "Analysis identifies three supported causal links: blank documentation caused lack of authorization, which constrained crew actions; and monitoring limitations mean recorded data may not reflect all disturbances. No physical cause for the air loss is established in this packet.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Origin of air loss (source/distribution/receiving)", "Actual pressure values at interruption time", "Whether field valves were open contrary to procedure"],
    "alternatives": [],
    "confidence": 0.85
  },
  "evidenceRequests": [
    "request structured-incident for origin details of air loss"
  ]
}
